subject: Testimonial Thank You — Rewards & Donation Receipt
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Katherine Liu <katherine.liu@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-07T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Testimonial Thank You — Rewards & Donation Receipt

Hi Katherine,

Thank you again for the great quote and the time you spent on the case study interview — the marketing update team loved the details. As promised, we want to send a thank-you package. We offer three common options; please let me know which you'd prefer: 

- $1,000 account credit applied to your Redwood invoices
- $200 Amazon e-gift card delivered to an email you specify
- $200 donation made in Acme's name to a 501(c)(3) charity (we can provide a donation receipt)

If you choose swag instead, we can ship a care package; we will need a shipping address and VAT/tax details if different from the billing address. If donation, please confirm the charity name and contact for receipts (we’ll request a receipt and copy it to your finance contact).

Attached is a short overview of options and timelines (gift-options.pdf). Our usual timeline is: process within 3 business days after confirmation; donation receipts typically arrive within 5–7 business days from the charity.

Next steps: reply with your choice and any required details (email for e-gift, shipping address, or charity info + finance contact).

Thanks again — we really appreciate Acme being open to being a reference.

Best,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0182

From: Katherine Liu <katherine.liu@acmecorp.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maria Torres <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T10:58:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Testimonial Thank You — Rewards & Donation Receipt

Diego — thanks, and congrats to your team on the write-up.

We'd prefer a donation in Acme's name. Can you donate to the Global Education Fund (GEF)? Their donation contact is donations@gef.org. For our internal expense reporting and audit we need:

- A donation receipt showing Acme Corp as the donor
- An approximate monetary value for our records (we expect $200)
- Copy the receipt to Maria Torres (procurement@acme.com)

No swag needed. Let me know if you need any additional PO or authorization from our side; Maria is cc'ed and can confirm if a PO is required.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Katherine
Katherine Liu
Head of Product Marketing | Acme Corp

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-07T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Testimonial Thank You — Rewards & Donation Receipt

Laura / Ben — forwarding Katherine's confirmation. Please: 

1) Process a $200 donation to Global Education Fund in Acme's name and request a donation receipt that lists Acme Corp as donor and the donation date (11/07/2026).
2) Copy Maria Torres (procurement@acme.com) on the receipt.
3) Apply the $1,000 testimonial account credit to Acme's Redwood account under DEAL-2026-ACME-174 (per our incentive policy) — we agreed to both a donation and a credit. Please confirm whether we should record the credit as immediate or on next billing cycle.

Attached: donation-invoice-template.docx (use for charity remittance note if helpful). If any PO/authorization required from Acme, I'll coordinate with Katherine/Maria.

Thanks — Diego

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-07T13:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Testimonial Thank You — Rewards & Donation Receipt

On it. Quick notes:

- I can submit a $200 donation via our corporate giving portal. GEF accepts ACH/wire; I need the charity EIN for the receipt (please confirm).
- We can issue the $1,000 account credit immediately; I'll create a credit memo and apply it to Acme's next invoice unless you want it to post as a pending credit balance (Ben?)
- For the donation receipt: do we want Redwood letterhead or the charity's receipt? Typically donors get an official charity receipt; we can also provide a Redwood cover letter if Acme needs a vendor-style PDF.

If there is a DocuSign authorization needed for the donation or to approve accounting entries, I can generate it — I will add a short approval text and include the HubSpot record.

Linking authorization here for your reference: https://www.docusign.com/transaction/0xA1B2C3-authorize

I'll proceed after Diego confirms the charity EIN and whether Acme wants the Redwood cover letter attached to the charity receipt.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Katherine Liu <katherine.liu@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-07T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Donation & Credit Confirmation — Acme / Redwood

Katherine — looping back with confirmation and the receipt attached.

We processed a $200 donation to Global Education Fund today (11/07/2026). Attached is the donation confirmation we received from GEF (donation_receipt_acme_20261107.pdf). The receipt lists Acme Corp as the donor and includes GEF's EIN for your records. We also applied a $1,000 account credit to your Redwood account (DEAL-2026-ACME-174); that credit is available now and will appear on your next invoice as a credit balance — if you'd rather it post as an immediate refund let us know and we can change the accounting treatment.

Thanks again for participating in the case study. If Maria needs any additional paperwork for procurement, I'm happy to provide a short vendor cover letter on Redwood letterhead.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Operations | Redwood Inference
